fusions.name: Treading the Clay
fusions.desc: Stomps the ground, which deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Yoked Heave
fusions.desc: A heavy blow that deals 32 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Labour
fusions.desc: After a 1.5-second cast, your damage rises 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Hair in the Mix
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
